topic: The True Story of the Economist Who Proved Small Savings Beats High Salaries

artifacts.angle: How a lesser-known economic study demonstrated that savings rate matters exponentially more than income level for achieving absolute financial freedom.
artifacts.hook: A groundbreaking study proved that someone making $45,000 can retire richer than someone making $150,000, just by changing one habit.
artifacts.title: Why $45k Beats $150k For Early Retirement
